key_insight: DecompRL teaches LLMs to decompose hard coding problems into modular sub-functions, making correct solutions much more reachable than direct generation.
engineering_relevance: This shifts inference cost from expensive GPU token generation to cheaper CPU-side recombination and evaluation, reducing GPU token cost by about 50×.
method: Use reinforcement learning to learn hierarchical code decomposition.
Generate and recombine multiple implementations for each module.
Exploit combinatorial search over module combinations to expand the solution space.
evidence_signal: On LiveCodeBench and CodeContests with Qwen 2.5 7B and Code World Model 32B, DecompRL outperforms standard and diversity-optimized RL baselines beyond 10^5 tokens per problem.
watch_item: The approach depends on the model learning useful modular decomposition, so performance may be sensitive to task structure and the cost of evaluating many recombined candidates.
paper_title: DecompRL: Solving Harder Problems by Learning Modular Code Generation
